method: Manual frozen-package review. Python serializes entered judgments; no Claude or other model CLI was called.
gold_comparison: Verdicts were recorded before reading Unit 2 gold labels, then compared. This manual same-session review is not the official Sonnet evaluation or a claim of benchmark independence.
